* Destiny 0 is rule-derived for every location. Locations have no deploy cost; no numerical deploy stat is supplied.<ref>[[:File:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Glossary (1998)]], page 84; [[:File:SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf|Advanced Rulebook (2023)]], pages 83–84.</ref>
* The Light Side game-text band is blank. The Dark Side words are transcribed from this frame; the physical original’s longer range/opponent-turn wording is not copied back into it. The original 1998 react cross-reference is at page 45; current replacement text is at Advanced Rulebook (2023), page 108.
